    Player Bio - Maradona

    Maradona is a professional footballer from Argentina. He is a 165cm | 5'5" tall, left-footed midfielder (CAM) who plays for EA FC ICONS in Icons. He was born on 30-10-1960.

    FC 27 Base Icon - Maradona

    Maradona's Icon card is rated 95. He has a 3-star weak foot and 5-star skill moves, giving him the ability to perform every skill move in the game. He does not have a real face in-game. He has been used in 1,049 games with a GPG (goals per game) of 1.33. He has been used in 183 games with a GPG (goals per game) of 1.372. The best chemistry style for him is Hunter. The best chemistry style for him is Basic. Maradona has 1 special card with rating 95.

    His current price on FUT is 8,150,000 on PlayStation, 8,150,000 on Xbox, and 6,800,000 on PC.
